C-PLANS-LIFECYCLE-DESKTOP-285.Summary: Replace the desktop plans lifecycle dropdown with a persistent one-action `Текущие | Архив` segmented control.
C-PLANS-LIFECYCLE-DESKTOP-285.Problem: The primary active/archive list mode is hidden among ordinary filters. Desktop users must open a select for a frequent mutually exclusive navigation state, while the selected plan can become stale after switching.

Goals.Goal: Keep `Текущие | Архив` permanently visible on desktop widths.
Reuse the existing `status=active|archived` lifecycle controller and API without client-side list merging.
Preserve search and ordinary filters, clear invalid detail deterministically and show mode-specific empty states.
Support pointer and keyboard operation with visible focus, 44 px targets and no required motion.

Constraints.Constraint: No mobile-specific mode, list/detail navigation, bottom sheet, gesture or mobile-only transition is added.
No API, SQLite schema, migration, plan lifecycle, archive/restore, source-row, evidence or document-intake change.
The original lifecycle select remains an internal compatibility bridge and is restored unchanged below 721 px.
Lifecycle view is never-learn: statistics cannot choose, reorder or reposition it.

NonGoals.NonGoal: Redesign the plan detail or source-row editor.
Add adaptive ranking or a saved personal lifecycle default.
Change persisted plan status by viewing a list.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: On desktop, one click or keyboard action switches between current and archived server-side lists.
The visible segmented control is the only accessible lifecycle selector on desktop; the bridge remains compatible with existing controllers and tests.
Search and ordinary filter values survive switching, while an absent selected plan cannot leave stale detail.
Empty states distinguish current, archive and filtered results without replacing loading or error messages.
Click, Enter, Space, Home, End and horizontal arrows work with role tablist/tab, aria-selected, roving tabindex, visible focus and targets at least 44 px.
Below 721 px the new segment is absent and the pre-existing select is restored; no new mobile interaction is introduced.
Focused tests, GRACE final and full project CI succeed on one exact head before squash merge and terminal archive.

VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: The exact branch head proves a desktop-only lifecycle segment over the existing server status without data, API or mobile feature changes.
